purpose: These wipes are used to gently clean the skin around wounds, cuts, scrapes, or injection sites. They help remove dirt, germs, and debris to reduce the chance of infection. They can also be used to clean skin before a medical procedure or injection.
how_it_works: These wipes are soaked in a saline solution, which is basically a gentle saltwater mixture that matches what your body naturally produces. This solution helps rinse away bacteria, dirt, and other unwanted materials from the skin without causing irritation. Because it closely mirrors your body's natural fluids, it is very gentle and safe to use on sensitive or broken skin.
common_side_effects: This product is generally very well tolerated. Occasionally, some people may notice mild skin irritation or a slight stinging sensation, especially if used on an open wound. These effects are usually minor and go away quickly.
warnings: These wipes are for external use only — do not swallow or use inside the eyes or ears unless specifically directed by a healthcare provider. Do not use on deep puncture wounds, serious burns, or animal bites without consulting a doctor first. Keep out of reach of children. If irritation, redness, or swelling gets worse after using, stop use and contact your doctor.
typical_dosing: Use one wipe to gently clean the affected skin area as needed. You can wipe the area once or twice to remove debris. Use a fresh wipe each time, and do not reuse the same wipe. Follow your healthcare provider's specific instructions if given.
